entries.camera: Over-the-shoulder view from behind and slightly above at the head of a grand staircase, wide lens, the figure's shoulder framing the left edge.
entries.subject: A figure seen from behind at the top of a vast sweeping staircase in a moonlit fey ballroom, wearing a long mantle that is not cloth but shimmering iridescent light, pouring down the steps like a waterfall of petals and gossamer. Below, a crowd of silhouetted guests all turn toward the mantle with raised hands, bathed in its glow and swaying as if under a spell. Glowing blossoms and fireflies drift through the air, and the marble banisters are wound with living vines.

entries.camera: Low-angle view looking up from among the shields, wide lens, the rampart and the sky towering overhead.
entries.subject: A tall silhouetted figure stands on a stone rampart seen from below, one arm raised high with a great curved war horn, a lute slung across the back. From the horn a ring of golden light rolls outward across a sea of raised round shields in the foreground, each dented bronze-rimmed shield catching the glow and flaring like a small sun. The shields carry plain heraldic shapes only, no lettering. Plain pennants snap in the wind against a dusk haze; an army rallying, no one under attack.

entries.camera: Straight-down overhead view, symmetrical, 35mm, the table dead centre in the frame.
entries.subject: Looking straight down at a round wooden table in a candlelit parlour: five pairs of hands, cropped at the wrists and in differing sleeves, rest flat around its edge. In the centre a small glass bowl lets a ghostly spiral of pale green light rise toward the camera. Translucent hands, ribbons of mist and the faint shapes of animals drift outward through the ring, passing between the living hands. Beside the bowl lie a small hand drum, a cluster of candles and a stack of blank, plain-backed cards.
entries.accent: ghostly pale jade-green with candle gold

entries.camera: Extreme wide, eye-level, perfectly symmetrical shot with the tiny figure at the bottom centre and enormous depth above.
entries.subject: At the centre of an enormous circular library whose walls of shelves climb out of sight, a tiny figure seen from behind stands holding a lute upright like a lantern. Hundreds of thin threads of golden light stream from the spines of unmarked books on every level and converge on the lute strings, as if the figure were plucking secrets straight off the shelves. Spiral staircases, floating lamps and a few drifting blank pages fill the hall. The book spines are blank and there is no writing anywhere.
entries.accent: warm parchment amber with deep ink-brown shadow

entries.camera: Wide side-on profile at eye level, 135mm telephoto compression, the figure and the creature's head facing each other across the frame.
entries.subject: At dusk on a cliff ledge a small silhouetted figure, seen from behind, stands calmly with one hand raised in greeting, facing the enormous head of a silver dragon that has lowered itself in profile to listen, one great eye half-closed in attention. Between the raised palm and the creature's snout a bright ribbon of pure silver light unspools and braids with a second ribbon flowing back from the dragon, the two weaving into one shining bridge. No fire, no bared teeth, no danger.
entries.accent: polished silver-white against royal sapphire dusk

entries.camera: Strongly canted (dutch-angle) mid-height frame, wide lens, frozen at a high shutter speed.
entries.subject: On a lantern-lit tavern stage two hands, cropped at the forearms, each hold a slim blade crossed in a dazzling flourish above a lute lying on the boards; where the steel meets, a burst of hot orange sparks scatters. Three glittering trails of light wrap the arms, one curving like a shield, one sweeping wide, one looping away. Tossed apples, halved cleanly in mid-air, and strips of cut silk fall around the flourish. A blurred velvet curtain and warm stage lamps glow behind.
entries.accent: hot orange sparks on dark steel-grey

entries.camera: Extreme macro at palm height, 100mm macro lens, razor-thin depth of field.
entries.subject: A pair of open hands in plain fingerless gloves, cropped at the wrists, cup a tiny orb of bright light that is unfolding in slow motion into a miniature brass music box, its gears and petals of golden light still turning into place as it forms. Faint musical ripples of light curl around the fingers. Far behind, blurred in a cluttered workshop, a teapot, a stool and a broom hover mid-dance, brought to life by the same glow.
entries.accent: bright mint-turquoise sparks with warm brass

entries.camera: Locked-off eye-level view framed through a large dark keyhole shape, black vignette at the edges, shallow depth of field.
entries.subject: Seen through a keyhole, a long dim masquerade ballroom where couples in masks stand frozen mid-waltz. In the middle a hooded silhouette with its back to us holds one gloved hand cupped beside the hood. From that hand dozens of thin threads of violet mist slither across the polished floor and rise to the frozen guests, who all tilt their heads toward them. Each thread ends in a tiny spiral of non-legible glyph shapes. Candles gutter and long shadows creep along the walls.
entries.accent: oily violet-black with a sickly magenta glow

entries.camera: Telephoto compression, 400mm look, a vast full moon filling half the frame with the tiny figure on a distant hilltop in front of it.
entries.subject: On a bare hilltop a tiny pure-black silhouette plays a crescent-shaped harp whose strings are strands of liquid moonlight drawn straight from the enormous full moon behind. A wide beam of milky light pours down the hillside onto the dark forest, gathering drifting moths, an owl in flight and a stag standing quietly at the treeline. Mist pools in the valley below and the whole scene is silent and calm.
entries.accent: milk-white moonlight over deep forest-green night

entries.camera: Wide eye-level side-on view with a slow-shutter long-exposure look: the dancer a soft motion blur, the surroundings crisp.
entries.subject: In a lantern-lit stone plaza at dusk a dancer in a long swirling coat spins on one foot, seen from the side as a blurred silhouette with the face turned away. Every footfall leaves a glowing ring of light on the flagstones, and long ribbons of motion trail spiral from the hem and outstretched hands, lifting petals and confetti into the air. A smaller silhouetted partner mirrors the step, fingertips joined. Strings of paper lanterns and a ring of cheering silhouettes blur behind.
entries.accent: warm coral-orange with dusky lavender shadow
